propositions: The Git version floor CI gate step reads .github/git-version-floor.txt from the checked-out patchset tree but hard-fails with exit 1 when the file is absent, even though the gate definition came from main and the patchset predates the commit that introduced the file.

Every in-flight change branched before the gate merged (c433663721) receives the gate step via the workflow definition from main but lacks the data file in its checked-out tree, causing false Verified -1 failures unrelated to actual Git version issues.

The gate must apply the existing if-present guard pattern documented in the repository (ticket ee2a) to skip gracefully when the floor file is absent from the tree, re-enforcing only on rebase or post-merge when the file is present.
An under-floor Git version must still fail with a diagnostic naming the required version, installed version, and upgrade path, preserving enforcement without regression.
